title: Hölder Continuity and Boundedness of Composition Operators on Pluriharmonic $α$-Bloch Spaces
summary: In this paper, we study the metric properties of pluriharmonic $α$-Bloch-type mappings $f=h+\overline{g}\in\mathcal{H}(\mathbb{B}^{n},\mathbb{C}^{n})$ on the unit ball $\mathbb{B}^{n}\subset\mathbb{C}^{n}$. By synthesizing local real-part estimates with the subharmonicity of $\log(\vert{} \det Dh(z) \vert{} + \vert{} \det Dg(z) \vert{})$ along hyperbolic geodesics, we establish a globalized non-trivial lower bound across the entire unit ball $\mathbb{B}^{n}$.
